name: harness-command-permission-response-always
notes: Sources/PhoneDSHAgentCore/AgentHarness.swift:259 and 185-189 (three decisions: allow_once, allow_always, deny). The DSH remote has no always outcome: allow_always degrades to allowed-once and the user is asked again next turn (DSHRemoteHarness.swift:134-137). The request side is harness-event permission_requested with a risk class (AgentHarness.swift:266-295).
